generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

technicalCriterionList.description: Total value of civl engineering works executed and payments received in the last five years (year-wise)
List of existing commitments and ongoing work
List of works for which tenders already submitted

To qualify for award of this contract, each tenderer should have satisfactorily completed minimum 05 Kms of Tentacle solar fence within 2 years. The work should be executed through Tender called by Eprocurement/Karnataka Public Procurement portal.
Tenderer should produce recent Residential Certificate, Aadhar/ PAN/ EPIC/ Passport/ Ration Card/ D.L. or any other relevant address proof.
Tenderer should produce recent GST Certificate & PAN Details.

To qualify for award of this contract, each Tenderer in its name should have in the last three years i.e. 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26 (a) Achieved in at least two financial years a minimum financial turnover (double the work estimate cost)
Turn over certificate of last three financial years (i.e. 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

technicalCriterionList.description: Each Tenderer should further demonstrate: (b) Liquid assets and /or availability of credit facilities of not less than 30% of the ECV.

In respect of Karnataka Forest Department S.S.R. based works tenderer should produce Forest Contract registration certificate for the year of 2026-27 from Forest Department and in respect of civil works, Tenderer should produce Contract Registration Certificate of PWD Department.
All terms and conditions as per tender document

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Past Experience certificate as Prime Contractor
Audited balance sheet for last three financial years
Turn over certificate of last three financial years i.e. 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26
Certificates from Nationalised banks for meeting the fund requirement Credit Lines/ Letter of Credit

In respect of Karnataka Forest Department S.S.R. based works tenderer should produce Forest Contract registration certificate for the year of 2026-27 from Forest Department and in respect of civil works, Tenderer should produce Contract Registration Certificate of PWD Department.
Tenderer should produce recent GST Certificate & PAN Details.
The tenderer should produce the quality certificate about the performance quality of the energizer by the central power research institute or equivalent.
The tenderer should produce the quality certificate about the quality of the insulator by the CIPET or equivalent.
Energiser test report must compiles the IS safety Standards
Notrified affidavit saying that the bidder is not black listed by any of the Government offices.
